analytics.note: GoatCounter, the same counter every sibling archive uses. No cookies, no personal data retained, open source, and it publishes a total the page can show — which is why it is here rather than something whose number only a dashboard sees. The public count needs «Allow adding visitor counts on your website» switched on in the GoatCounter settings; it is off by default and deliberately so. Empty code means no script, no request and no placeholder.
